Placemaker.UI.Area.HowDraw: Click corners, then the first one
Placemaker.UI.Area.PointsNodes: Over a junction a corner snaps to the road node; two in a row follow the road. Alt: no snapping.
Placemaker.UI.Arrangement.Hint: Repeats in this order along the edges
Placemaker.UI.BiomeMix.Title: Landscape
Placemaker.UI.Build.GroupTip: On: it is built as one asset. Click it to select all of it; the bulldozer removes all of it. Off: built as separate pieces, as if you placed them yourself: you click, change and bulldoze them one at a time, and it can't be edited or removed as a whole.
Placemaker.UI.Build.KeepAreaTip: On: after building, the area stays selected and Placemaker stays open, so you can build something else there. Off: Build closes Placemaker.
Placemaker.UI.Building.Title: Building…
Placemaker.UI.Entrances.Title: Entrances
Placemaker.UI.Feature.NoRoom: No room for it in this area.
Placemaker.UI.Fit.NoRoomHint: Make the area bigger or turn other extras off.
Placemaker.UI.Ground.DecalsTip: Cracks, grime, leaves, puddles and wear drawn on the ground. Off: no decals at all. Terrain paint is separate: it colours the map's own ground.
Placemaker.UI.Ground.Title: Ground
Placemaker.UI.Info.EditTip: Opens Placemaker on it: change the design, then build again to replace it.
Placemaker.UI.Info.FeeOff: Free: drivers park here without paying.
Placemaker.UI.Info.Missing: Some assets it used are missing (a mod or asset pack was removed). Edit to replace them.
Placemaker.UI.Info.Modified: Changed with other tools since it was built. Editing rebuilds it from its design.
Placemaker.UI.Info.RemoveAsk: Remove all of it? Buildings that grew next to it stay.
Placemaker.UI.Info.UngroupAsk: Ungroup it for good? Its pieces become separate, as if you placed them yourself. This can't be undone.
Placemaker.UI.LauncherTip: Choose an area and turn it into a park, plaza, parking lot, streets… or your own mix.
Placemaker.UI.Legend.AllTip: Show every layer as it was
Placemaker.UI.Legend.RowTip: Hover: show only this on the map. Click: hide it.
Placemaker.UI.Legend.RowTipHidden: Hidden on the map. Click to show it.
Placemaker.UI.Library.Title: Placemaker library
Placemaker.UI.LockedHint: Click to let Randomize change it again.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.CantEdit: This was built by an older version and can only be removed.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.Hover: Click something you built to edit it
Placemaker.UI.Manage.RemoveText: Everything Placemaker built here is bulldozed.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.UngroupText: Its pieces become separate, as if you placed them yourself: you change and bulldoze them one at a time, and it has no upkeep of its own. This can't be undone.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.UngroupTip: Make its pieces separate for good, as if you placed them yourself. This can't be undone.
Placemaker.UI.Marker.AlleyTip: A small road junction through the edge.
Placemaker.UI.Marker.TwoWayTip: Cars drive in and out here.
Placemaker.UI.Markers.BannerFor: Placing {0} — click on the outline. Right-click takes back the last one.
Placemaker.UI.Markers.CrosswalkItemTip: On: a crosswalk across the street here. Off: the path stops at the sidewalk.
Placemaker.UI.Markers.CrosswalkTip: On: the entrances you place next get a crosswalk across the street (the path joins the road at a new junction). Off: the path stops at the sidewalk and the game joins it, with no crosswalk and no cut in the road. Each placed entrance has its own switch below.
Placemaker.UI.Markers.Hint: Click the outline to add; right-click takes back the last one.
Placemaker.UI.Markers.Note: Pick a type, then click the outline by a road.
Placemaker.UI.Mock.Timeout: Planning took too long and was stopped.
Placemaker.UI.ModeOutgrowTip: The whole city's outgrow: each zone type's default, the brush, the map lens, the outgrow types and their numbers.
Placemaker.UI.ModePlacemakerTip: Make roads, parks, car parks, shops and zones in an area you pick.
Placemaker.UI.MoveTip: Drag to move. Double-click to dock.
Placemaker.UI.NoSettings: No settings: adapts to the area.
Placemaker.UI.Outgrow.Cost2: Outgrow's own work: {0} ms a frame
Placemaker.UI.Painter.ThemeTip.zone3: Each building gets its zone type's outgrow type (Outgrow, its Defaults)
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Applied.Tip: The game uses this value for the build.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Attractiveness.M: Draws tourists: adds to your city's tourism attractiveness.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Capacity.Meaning: How many nearby streets the park can serve before it gets crowded.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Entertainment.Me: Wellbeing boost for residents within reach.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.KeepVanilla.Tip: Keeps every value inside what vanilla parks of a similar size use.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Leisure.Meaning: How much fun one visit gives a citizen looking for something to do.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.NoRoad: No road edge: only tourism applies.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Note: Only attractiveness reaches the game here. The others are saved with the build.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.NoteCompanion: A small hidden park building at the road edge carries these stats, like a vanilla park.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Outside: Some values are beyond what vanilla parks this size have; the city may feel unbalanced.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Range.Meaning: How far residents walk to enjoy the park (path cost, about metres).
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Shown.Tip: Needs the companion park building (road edge and setting); saved with the build.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Title: Park stats
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Ungrouped: Not grouped as one asset: no park stats and no upkeep. Turn on "Group as one asset" to make it a park.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Upkeep.Meaning: Monthly running cost a vanilla park this good would have.
Placemaker.UI.PickRecipe: Nothing picked yet: pick a category to start
Placemaker.UI.Picker.HoverHint: Hover to preview, click to use
Placemaker.UI.Places.Title: Places inside
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ApplyZone.Message: Every building of this zone gets its type, also the ones you painted.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ApplyZone.Title: Give {0} this type?
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ApplyZoneTip: This zone's buildings get this type now, also the ones you painted
Placemaker.UI.Polish.BrushOffTip: Brush: buildings you drag over lose their outgrow (outgrow type Off).
Placemaker.UI.Polish.BrushPaintTip5: Brush: buildings you drag over get this outgrow type. Right-click drops the stroke.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.BrushZoneTip: Brush: buildings you drag over get their zone's default outgrow type back.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ByZoneNote4: Each building gets the outgrow type its zone type has. Change them in Outgrow (the switcher at the top), or pick any type here to outgrow the area with it.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.DeleteMessage2: Its buildings keep their look until they are outgrown again.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.LauncherTip: Pick buildings and outgrow their gardens: shared fences and hedges, lawns or painted ground, planting, by theme.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.LensStatusTip2: Outgrown or not, and what is waiting
Placemaker.UI.Polish.LensTypesTip: Every building in its outgrow type's color
Placemaker.UI.Polish.LiveTip: On: the buildings in the selection are outgrown again a moment after every change you make, and the selection stays. Remove outgrow puts them back.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.Name: Outgrow
Placemaker.UI.Polish.NewOffTip: Buildings that grow get no outgrow until you paint them
Placemaker.UI.Polish.NewZoneDefaultTip: Buildings that grow get their zone's default outgrow type
Placemaker.UI.Polish.PickToEdit2: Pick an outgrow type to see and change it. Saving a built-in one changes it everywhere it is used; Copy as new makes your own.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.PlantingTip: What is planted and placed in the land: Garden (lawns, beds, a sand pit or a bench), Natural (wild ground, rocks, logs), Tidy (lawns, hedges, flower beds), Yard (worn ground, pallets, rubble). The rows below fine-tune it.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ResetAll: Reset all buildings to their zone's type
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ResetAll.Message: Every building gets its zone's outgrow type again, also the ones you painted. On a big city this takes a while.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ResetAll.Title: Reset all buildings to their zone's type?
Placemaker.UI.Polish.SaveBuiltIn: Save: this is what {0} is from now on, everywhere it is used
Placemaker.UI.Polish.SaveMessage: {0} building(s) use it. They update right away.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ShowOffTip: Every building as the game made it; each keeps its outgrow type for later
Placemaker.UI.Polish.TabEditTip: Every outgrow type and its settings: change one, or make your own
Placemaker.UI.Polish.TabZoneDefaultsTip2: The default outgrow type of each zone, and what new buildings get
Placemaker.UI.Polish.TypeColorTip: Its color on the map (the lens's Types).
Placemaker.UI.Preset.CantSave: This style can't be saved over
Placemaker.UI.Preset.DeleteText: Your style is removed. Builds stay as they are.
Placemaker.UI.Preset.ResetText: Your changes to this style are dropped.
Placemaker.UI.Preset.ResetTip: Bring back “{0}” as it comes with Placemaker.
Placemaker.UI.Preset.SaveAsTip: Save these settings as a new style
Placemaker.UI.Preset.SaveOverTip: “{0}” uses these settings from now on. Reset brings back the shipped one.
Placemaker.UI.Preview.RealNote: Roads only *snap* to the ground once built, *clipping* is possible until then, and *terrain paint* comes at the end.
Placemaker.UI.Preview.RealTip: See-through game models and textures, exactly what will be built.
Placemaker.UI.Preview.SketchTip: Fast outlines and dots. Best while drawing and trying things.
Placemaker.UI.ResizeHeightTip: Drag to make it taller or shorter. Double-click for full height.
Placemaker.UI.ResizeTip: Drag to make it wider or narrower. Double-click for the default width.
Placemaker.UI.Review.AckTip: Some changes stay after you remove the build (the amber tags). Click it to allow them.
Placemaker.UI.Review.Later.Paint.Tip: The ground is painted when you build; the preview cannot show it.
Placemaker.UI.Review.Later.Plots.Tip: Shops and homes grow on the zoned plots after the build, as the city needs them.
Placemaker.UI.Review.Later.Terrain.Tip: The ground is raised and lowered when you build; the preview cannot show it. Turn on Terrain in the top view to see where.
Placemaker.UI.Review.Later.Water.Tip: Ponds and pools fill with water after the build.
Placemaker.UI.Review.PaintOnly: Removing the build wipes its ground paint; separate pieces keep it.
Placemaker.UI.Review.UpkeepPark: Includes the park's running cost: ¢{0} a month, like a vanilla park this good.
Placemaker.UI.Review.UpkeepTip: What the city pays for it each month.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.AllStopsTip: Lit when it stops at everything here. Click to turn them all on, or all off when they are all on.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.BlockTip2: A stroke stays in what the Paint bucket would fill where it started.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.BuildsTip: Keep off what you built with Placemaker.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.GapTip: Openings narrower than this count as closed, and places narrower than it are left out. 0 = off.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.LotsTip2: Keep off other lots (other mods, extractors).
Placemaker.UI.Rules.ReachTip: How far the fill may spread from where you click. In open land it fills a circle this size.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.RoadsTip2: Stop at the curb of every road, its junctions and turning circles.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.SmartTip: On: the brush stops at what you switch on below. Off: it paints over everything.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.SmoothTip: How smooth the painted edge is.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.SnapTip: Pulls painted edges this close onto a curb.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.StopsTip: What the area never covers, for every tool. Red on the map.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningBuiltTip: Keep off zoned cells that have a building.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningGridTip: Keep off the whole zone grid along the streets, even cells nobody zoned.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningTip: How much of the zoning the area keeps off.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningZonedTip: Keep off every zoned cell, built on or not.
Placemaker.UI.SitePlan.Title: Top view
Placemaker.UI.Tool.BucketTip2: Click to fill the land up to what it stops at. Shift+click adds more, right-click starts over.
Placemaker.UI.Tool.PaintTip: Brush the area on. Shift+drag erases, right-click starts over.
Placemaker.UI.Tool.PointsTip2: Click corners, then the first one to close; right-click starts over. Snaps to curbs, right angles and road nodes: two corners on road nodes follow the road between them.
Placemaker.UI.Touches.Active: Click on the map. Click again to undo it; right-click takes back the last one.
Placemaker.UI.Touches.Count: {0} hand edits, kept when you edit or rebuild.
Placemaker.UI.Touches.Hint: Pick one, then click on the map.
Placemaker.UI.Version.Mismatch: Restart the game: Placemaker's files were updated while it was running.
Placemaker.UI.Walls.TracksTip: Train and tram tracks on the ground.
Placemaker.UI.Why.NotNow: Not available with the current settings
Placemaker.UI.Why.NotUsed: Not used by this style here
Placemaker.UI.Why.RestartForMode: Restart the game to use this: Placemaker was updated while the game was running.
Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.EditTypeTip2: Opens this outgrow type in Outgrow's Edit tab: a change there is for every zone that uses it.
Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.GridTip: Its lots, in zone cells (one cell is 8 m), the road along the bottom: the solid block is the smallest lot, the lighter one the biggest; each lot picks a size between. Click or drag near a corner to move it.
Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.OutgrowOnTip: On: this zone's buildings outgrow their lots with the outgrow type beside it. Off: they stay as the game makes them.
Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.RoadTip3: Allowed road width: the roads this zone may line, by their width (two lanes 16 m, four lanes 24 m, six lanes 32 m). Its lots are only placed along roads in this range.
Placemaker.UI.ZoningCaption: Places [vanilla zoning], same as zoning by hand. [Outgrow] is a separate feature.
